# Specified Development

![Specified Development — Make intent explicit. Build from reviewed specifications.](../spec/assets/hero.png)

Specified Development is a programming paradigm built on GitHub Spec Kit: a living present-tense spec expands through spec → plan → independent tests → tasks, and every change starts as a spec edit whose gap propagates downstream. The current checkout provides portable Python tools to validate native task bundles, render compact reviews, and expand exact inputs. The planned preset, extension, and source-directory compiler have separate qualification gates.

- Check the [current delivery status and qualification evidence](../REVIEW.md#delivery-status).
- Run the [portable bundle tools](../docs/bundle-validation.md).
- Check [current specification metadata and requirement coverage](../docs/specification-review.md), and inspect the [generated task review](../docs/task-review.md).
- Run the [validation and quality checks](../docs/quality-checks.md).
- Read the [complete product specification](../spec/index.md) and its [authority contract](../spec/contracts/authority.md).
- Read the [project README](../README.md), and inspect the historical 60-task design in the [legacy bundle review](../build/bundle-review/README.md).
